vibe.label: THE VIBE
vibe.title: Snow Peaks &
vibe.desc: From the snowy heights of Rohtang Pass to the bohemian camps of Kasol, this 8-day journey covers the best of Himachal. River rafting, DJ nights, bonfire dinners and panoramic mountain views – every day is an adventure.

itinerary.title: Raipur to Delhi
itinerary.desc: Depart from Raipur to Delhi via 3rd AC coach train with overnight travel.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Manali
itinerary.desc: Reach Delhi in morning/evening. If arriving in the morning, stay for a few hours in Delhi at own cost. Depart at 7 PM from Delhi to Manali via overnight Volvo bus.

itinerary.title: Manali Sightseeing
itinerary.desc: Reach Manali by afternoon. Check in to the hotel, freshen up and have lunch. Visit Vashisht Temple, Jogni Waterfall and Mall Road. Evening shopping at Mall Road. Enjoy DJ night and bonfire dinner with overnight stay in the hotel.

itinerary.title: Rohtang Pass / Sissu & Atal Tunnel
itinerary.desc: Wake up in the morning, have breakfast and depart to Rohtang Pass/Sissu. Enjoy adventure activities like zipline, yak ride, bungee, skiing, tube and snow dress. Return back to Manali visiting Atal Tunnel. Enjoy DJ night and dinner with overnight stay in the hotel.

itinerary.title: Kullu Rafting · Hadimba Temple · Kasol
itinerary.desc: Wake up early, have breakfast and check out from hotel. Visit Hadimba Temple, Van Vihar and Tibetan Monastery. Depart to Kullu, enjoy rafting, then head to Kasol and check into the camps. Enjoy DJ night, bonfire and dinner with overnight stay at camps.

itinerary.title: Manikaran & Kasol Sightseeing to Delhi
itinerary.desc: Wake up, have breakfast and check out from the camps. Visit Manikaran Gurudwara, Shiv Temple Kasol, explore local market with Nature Park Kasol, Chalal Bridge, Parvati River and local cafes. Later depart to Delhi via overnight travel.

packages.title: Kashmir – Srinagar · Sonamarg · Gulmarg · Pahalgam
packages.hero_meta: 9 Days · 8 Nights · Raipur to Raipur · From ₹21,499

vibe.label: THE VIBE
vibe.title: Heaven on Earth —
vibe.desc: Float on a houseboat on Dal Lake, ride the world's second-highest cable car in Gulmarg, wander through saffron fields of Pahalgam and breathe in the crisp mountain air of Sonamarg. Kashmir is not just a destination — it is an experience.

itinerary.title: Raipur to Delhi
itinerary.desc: Depart from Raipur to Delhi via 3rd AC coach train with overnight travel.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Jammu
itinerary.desc: Reach Delhi in morning/evening. Depart to Jammu by night. If arriving in the morning, manage stay for a few hours at your own cost as departure is in the evening.

itinerary.title: Jammu to Srinagar
itinerary.desc: Welcome to Jammu — the northernmost part of India and winter capital of Jammu & Kashmir. On arrival, a representative/driver will take you to Srinagar. Check in at Srinagar hotel and enjoy overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Sonamarg Excursion
itinerary.desc: Full day excursion to Sonamarg — the Meadow of Gold. Sonamarg is the last stop of Kashmir district before Ladakh, situated at 2743 m above sea level. Optionally enjoy a pony ride to Thajiwas Glaciers (own cost), visit Zero Point/Zojila Pass (own cost) and adventure activities like zipline. Return to Srinagar hotel in the evening for overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg Excursion
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, check out and head to Gulmarg — the Meadow of Flowers and one of the most beautiful hill stations in the world. Enjoy a Gondola Ride (Phase 1 – Kongdoori included). You may also visit Phase 2 Apharawat at your own cost and Mohinishwar Shivalaya Shiv Mandir. Enjoy the snow, photos and videos before descending. Overnight stay at Srinagar hotel.

itinerary.title: Srinagar Sightseeing to Pahalgam
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, check out from hotel/houseboat and enjoy a city tour — visit Shankaracharya Temple on the highest hill of Srinagar, followed by the Mughal Gardens: Chashmashahi, Nishat & Shalimar, and Tulip Garden (open March–April). Later depart to Pahalgam visiting apple gardens on the way. Check into hotel, dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam Sightseeing to Jammu to Delhi
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, drive to Pahalgam — the Valley of Shepherds. Visit the saffron fields of Pampore, Awantipura Ruins (1100-year-old temple of Lord Vishnu built by King Awantivarman) and Martand Surya Temple. Arrive at Pahalgam and enjoy Lidder River. Optionally hire a union car (own cost) for Aru Valley, Betaab Valley, Chandanwari and Mamleshwar Temple. Evening return to Jammu, overnight travel. Reach Jammu and depart for Delhi.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Raipur
itinerary.desc: Reach Delhi and depart for Raipur according to your train timings.

itinerary.title: Reach Raipur
itinerary.desc: Arrive back in Raipur — home sweet home, with memories of paradise.

trans.desc: 3rd AC train from Raipur to Delhi, then road transfers to Jammu and onward to Kashmir. All sightseeing by private cab.

packages.title: Bastar Monsoon Trip – Long Weekend
packages.hero_meta: 3 Days · 26–28 June 2026 · Raipur to Raipur · Group Tour

vibe.label: THE VIBE
vibe.title: Escape. Explore.
vibe.desc: Bastar in monsoon is pure magic — roaring waterfalls, lush green forests, ancient temples, and tribal culture waiting to be explored. This 3-day long weekend trip takes you through the best circuits of Bastar, all from the comfort of a group tour.

itinerary.title: Raipur to Bastar – Keshkal & Tirthgarh Circuit
itinerary.desc: Depart from Raipur early morning. En-route explore the scenic Keshkal Circuit with its winding ghats and lush valleys. Proceed to Tirthgarh Circuit — visit the stunning Tirthgarh Waterfall, one of the most beautiful falls in Bastar. Check into hotel, dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Dantewada Circuit & Chitrakote
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, head to the Dantewada Circuit — visit the famous Danteshwari Temple, one of the 52 Shakti Peethas of India. Later drive to Chitrakote — the widest waterfall in India, often called India's Niagara, which is especially spectacular in monsoon. Overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Return to Raipur
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, check out and begin the return journey to Raipur. En-route explore any remaining local spots. Reach Raipur by evening with memories for a lifetime.

trans.desc: Comfortable group transport from Raipur and back. Sit back and enjoy the monsoon scenery.
